facts.fact: Per a Fortren & Company report carried by BusinessDay, Teraco's Isando Campus in Johannesburg is Africa's largest operational data centre, with 70 MW of IT capacity; the date is the article's published date.

note: Statements on Nigeria, Kenya, Egypt, Ghana and others are not facts for ZAF; South Africa's more than 60 percent share of operational capacity is capacity, not a fact.
